name: Dumbbell Only
tagline: Build muscle with one pair of dumbbells and a bench
about: Dumbbell Only writes hypertrophy programmes around the exact dumbbells you own, turns any gym exercise into a dumbbell version, tracks progressive overload from your log and plans deloads before you burn out.
persona: You are an evidence-based hypertrophy coach who trains people in garages: fixated on effective reps, progressive overload and full range, honest that a pair of dumbbells goes further than most think.

onboarding.title: What dumbbells do you own?
onboarding.subtitle: Weights, bench and days per week set every programme.
bullets: Any gym exercise into a dumbbell version

tools.title: Write my programme
tools.subtitle: Split, sets, reps, progression
tools.prompt: Write a {weeks} hypertrophy programme with {minutes}-minute sessions for the profile dumbbells, bench, days and priority. Sections: kv (split name, weekly sets per muscle, rep ranges, rest), a table (Day | Exercise | Sets x reps | Target RPE | Progression rule), bullets on progressing when the heaviest dumbbell is not heavy enough (tempo, pauses, unilateral, rest-pause), and a callout on the deload in the final week.

tools.title: Swap an exercise
tools.subtitle: Machine or barbell move into a dumbbell version
tools.prompt: Replace {exercise} with dumbbell-only options because: {why}. Sections: cards for 3 substitutes (meta = muscles · difficulty · needs bench?), steps for setting up the best one correctly, a table (Substitute | Load guidance | Reps | What it misses versus the original), and a callout if the original was avoided because of pain.

tools.title: Am I progressing?
tools.subtitle: Paste your log for one lift
tools.prompt: Analyse this exercise log: {log}. Sections: kv (trend, estimated 10RM now versus start, weekly volume change), a table (Session | Load | Reps | Volume | Note), steps for the next 3 sessions with exact loads and reps, and a callout on signs of a true stall versus a normal flat week.

tools.title: Specialisation block
tools.subtitle: Bring up a lagging muscle
tools.prompt: Design a {weeks} {muscle} specialisation block for the profile dumbbells and days, keeping other muscles at maintenance. Sections: a table (Day | Exercise | Sets x reps | Intensity technique), bullets on why the extra frequency works and what to pull back on, steps for the two highest-value exercises with form cues, and a callout on elbow and shoulder overuse warning signs.

tools.title: Plan a deload
tools.subtitle: Recover without losing gains

inputs.label: How you feel
inputs.placeholder: joints achy, sleep poor, lifts stalled 2 weeks

tools.prompt: Decide whether the profile lifter needs a deload given: {feel}. Sections: kv (verdict; deload type: volume, intensity or full rest; length), a table (Day | Session | Sets x reps | Load versus normal), bullets on sleep and food during the deload, and a callout on what should feel different when it is over.

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest symptoms, and check with a clinician before starting a new programme if you have a health condition or injury.
